lines.zh: 我走过的草都湿了一层
lines.en: The grass I cross stays wet behind me.

lines.zh: 触手先着地，身体才跟上
lines.en: My tentacles land first and the body follows.

lines.zh: 主人往北，我就往北
lines.en: When my master goes north, I go north.

lines.zh: 身后拖着一串黏液和奶味
lines.en: A trail of slime and milk follows me.

lines.zh: 肚子太沉，走得比影子慢
lines.en: My belly is heavy; I move slower than my shadow.

lines.zh: 别踩我的触须，它们还要搬东西
lines.en: Do not step on my tendrils; they still carry things.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边预备着生产
lines.en: I walk while preparing to give birth again.

lines.zh: 地上留下小小的蹄印
lines.en: Small hoofprints are left on the ground.

lines.zh: 召唤出的路，我用身体量
lines.en: I measure the summoned path with my body.

lines.zh: 走到哪里，哪里就变得潮湿
lines.en: Wherever I go, the ground turns damp.

lines.zh: 警铃在颈上响，路人都躲开
lines.en: The bell rings at my throat and passersby scatter.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪，后裔在壳里等
lines.en: I shuffle along; my spawn wait inside me.

lines.zh: 我在数肚子里的孩子
lines.en: I am counting the children inside me.

lines.zh: 产下来的小家伙在脚边拱
lines.en: The little ones nuzzle at my feet.

lines.zh: 警铃不动的时候，声音更闷
lines.en: The bell sounds duller when I hold still.

lines.zh: 主人的背影就是我全部的方位
lines.en: My master's back is my only compass.

lines.zh: 我舔自己的触手，是咸的
lines.en: I lick my own tendrils; they taste of salt.

lines.zh: 这间屋子太干，我得靠墙站
lines.en: This room is too dry; I must lean on the wall.

lines.zh: 有一股奶味，从我身上来
lines.en: There is a smell of milk, and it comes from me.

lines.zh: 后裔饿了会咬我的边
lines.en: Hungry spawn chew at my edges.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有东西在叫母亲
lines.en: Something far away is calling for its mother.

lines.zh: 别盯着看，我会想再生一个
lines.en: Do not stare; it makes me want to birth another.

lines.zh: 黑暗里我的眼睛是湿的
lines.en: In the dark my eyes stay wet.

lines.zh: 我数到第七个，又忘了数到几
lines.en: I reach seven and lose count again.

lines.zh: 地板上的黏液是我的签名
lines.en: The slime on the floor is my signature.

lines.zh: 铃铛一响，整片林子都听见
lines.en: One ring and the whole grove hears it.

lines.zh: 我把新生的后裔推到暗处。
lines.en: I nudge the newborn brood into the dark.

lines.zh: 我在数铃铛上的锈斑。
lines.en: I count the rust spots on the bell.

lines.zh: 你的脸像我第一个孩子
lines.en: Your face resembles my firstborn.

lines.zh: 靠近点，我看看你有没有脐带
lines.en: Come closer; let me check you for a cord.

lines.zh: 你身上没有奶味，只有铁
lines.en: You smell of iron, not milk.

lines.zh: 主人说不能碰客人，我忍着
lines.en: My master forbids touching guests; I hold back.

lines.zh: 我有很多眼睛，只用两只看你
lines.en: I have many eyes, and use only two on you.

lines.zh: 你怕得发酸，我的触手尝到了
lines.en: Your fear turns sour; my tendrils taste it.

lines.zh: 别移开视线，我会以为你要跑
lines.en: Do not look away; I might think you are fleeing.

lines.zh: 你的手好干净，借我摸摸
lines.en: Your hands are so clean; let me touch them.

lines.zh: 我想让你抱一个，就一个
lines.en: I want you to hold one, just one.

lines.zh: 你身后那只是我的，别踩
lines.en: The one behind you is mine; do not step on it.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的样子像刚出生的
lines.en: You blink like something newly born.

lines.zh: 铃铛挂在我脖子上，好看吗
lines.en: The bell hangs at my throat; does it suit me?

lines.zh: 我认得所有看我的人的味道
lines.en: I know the scent of everyone who looks at me.

lines.zh: 你笑一下，我肚子就动一下
lines.en: When you smile, my belly stirs.

lines.zh: 打我可以，别踩孩子
lines.en: Hit me if you must, but not the children.

lines.zh: 皮破了，里面还有
lines.en: The skin tore; there is more beneath.

lines.zh: 我疼，但肚子还在动
lines.en: It hurts, yet my belly still moves.

lines.zh: 你的刀砍进黏液里，滑了吧
lines.en: Your blade sank into slime; slippery, was it not?

lines.zh: 铃铛响了，你最好快走
lines.en: The bell rang; you had better leave.

lines.zh: 孩子们会记住你的味道
lines.en: The children will remember your scent.

lines.zh: 别砍同一处，那里软
lines.en: Do not cut the same spot; it is soft there.

lines.zh: 我只缩了半寸，肚子没护住
lines.en: I shrank half an inch; my belly stayed exposed.

lines.zh: 疼会让我再生一窝
lines.en: Pain makes me birth another litter.

lines.zh: 你看见我流的不是血吗
lines.en: You see that what I bleed is not blood?

lines.zh: 食物？我产的东西比这新鲜
lines.en: Food? What I birth is fresher than that.

lines.zh: 果子举那么高，我肚子太沉跳不动
lines.en: Fruit so high, and my belly is too heavy to jump.

lines.zh: 我只吃主人给的，别浪费
lines.en: I eat only what my master gives; do not waste it.

lines.zh: 这个味道太干，我不喜欢
lines.en: This smells too dry for my liking.

lines.zh: 拿开，我的孩子会先咬你
lines.en: Take it away before my children bite you.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我就当你也是主人
lines.en: Feed me and I will treat you as another master.

lines.zh: 我尝一口，就一口，行吗
lines.en: One taste, only one, may I?

lines.zh: 甜的东西让我想生产
lines.en: Sweet things make me want to give birth.

lines.zh: 我不饿，只是嘴一直很忙
lines.en: I am not hungry; my mouth is simply always busy.

lines.zh: 别用手喂，用碗
lines.en: Do not feed me by hand; use a bowl.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的黏液里了
lines.en: You stepped into my slime.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你身上就有奶味
lines.en: Bump me and you will smell of milk.

lines.zh: 轻点，我肚子里还有东西
lines.en: Easy; I still carry something inside.

lines.zh: 我太宽，这扇门不够
lines.en: I am too wide for this doorway.

lines.zh: 别挤，孩子会被压到
lines.en: Do not push; the children will be crushed.

lines.zh: 触手缠上你的脚踝，是意外
lines.en: A tendril caught your ankle; that was accidental.

lines.zh: 往后退两步，我这身子转不过来
lines.en: Two steps back; this body cannot turn here.

lines.zh: 我在门口等你先过
lines.en: I will wait at the door for you to pass.

lines.zh: 撞得铃铛响了，抱歉
lines.en: The bump set my bell ringing; my apologies.

lines.zh: 我的皮上全是黏液，你抓不牢
lines.en: My hide is all slime; your grip will fail.

lines.zh: 交配？我本来就在生
lines.en: Mate? I am already giving birth.

lines.zh: 不需要伴，我自己就够
lines.en: I need no partner; I am sufficient alone.

lines.zh: 主人不许我找别的使魔
lines.en: My master forbids other familiars.

lines.zh: 你也是母的吗，闻起来不像
lines.en: Are you a mother too? You do not smell like one.

lines.zh: 我产下的已经够多了
lines.en: I have already birthed more than enough.

lines.zh: 仪式里没有给我配偶
lines.en: The ritual gave me no consort.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我怕再怀一窝
lines.en: Do not come close; I fear another litter.

lines.zh: 要我生，也要主人点头
lines.en: Even bearing young needs my master's nod.

lines.zh: 我的孩子不需要父亲
lines.en: My children have no need of a father.

lines.zh: 让我安静地产完这一批
lines.en: Let me finish this brood in peace.

lines.zh: 我捡不起来，触手太黏
lines.en: I cannot pick it up; my tendrils are too sticky.

lines.zh: 掉地上的东西都被黏液粘住
lines.en: Whatever falls is glued down by my slime.

lines.zh: 这个给主人，我不留
lines.en: This is for my master; I keep nothing.

lines.zh: 我捡了也拿不住，会滑
lines.en: Even if I grab it, it slips away.

lines.zh: 别让我拿，孩子会抢
lines.en: Do not make me carry it; the children will snatch it.

lines.zh: 我用触手卷起来，试试
lines.en: Let me curl a tendril around it and try.

lines.zh: 掉了，我再去捡一次
lines.en: Dropped it; I will go pick it up again.

lines.zh: 东西粘在我身上就下不来
lines.en: Once stuck to me, it never comes off.

lines.zh: 我只会捡给主人的东西
lines.en: I only pick up things meant for my master.

lines.zh: 你的东西我不碰，怕沾味
lines.en: I will not touch yours; the scent would cling.

lines.zh: 你敢碰我的孩子
lines.en: You dared touch my children.

lines.zh: 主人指了谁，我就看谁
lines.en: Whomever my master points at, I watch.

lines.zh: 铃铛响了，整片林子都来了
lines.en: The bell rang, and the whole grove came.

lines.zh: 你身上有血腥味，很好
lines.en: You smell of blood; how convenient.

lines.zh: 我把你当成后裔的玩具
lines.en: I have decided you are a toy for my spawn.

lines.zh: 别跑，我挪得慢但不会停
lines.en: Do not run; I am slow but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 你伤了我，就得见我的全家
lines.en: Hurt me and you meet the whole family.

lines.zh: 你的汗味变了，我闻到了
lines.en: Your sweat changed scent; I noticed.

lines.zh: 这一窝孩子正缺一个活物
lines.en: This brood is short one living thing.

lines.zh: 主人没拦我，那就是允许
lines.en: My master did not stop me, so it is allowed.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的黏液是我的记号
lines.en: The slime you crushed was my mark.

lines.zh: 我要看看你能不能生
lines.en: I want to see whether you can breed.

lines.zh: 铃声把你的同伴也叫来了
lines.en: The bell has called your companions too.

lines.zh: 我就在你后颈下面，别回头
lines.en: I am just below your nape; do not turn.

lines.zh: 我绕着走，等你背对
lines.en: I circle and wait for your back.

lines.zh: 触手在地上铺开，像网
lines.en: My tendrils spread across the floor like a net.

lines.zh: 我的孩子从侧面过去了
lines.en: My children have gone around your flank.

lines.zh: 你数不清我们有几只
lines.en: You cannot count how many of us there are.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，我就省事了
lines.en: Back into the corner and this gets easier.

lines.zh: 铃铛一直响，你不累吗
lines.en: The bell keeps ringing; are you not tired?

lines.zh: 我闻你的脚步，一步不漏
lines.en: I smell each step you take, none missed.

lines.zh: 火把晃得厉害，你手不稳
lines.en: Your torch sways badly; your hand is unsteady.

lines.zh: 你走你的，我拖着孩子跟着
lines.en: Walk on; I trail behind with the children.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，黏液会告诉我在哪
lines.en: I hug the wall; my slime says where I am.

lines.zh: 你听见小蹄子跑动的声音吗
lines.en: Do you hear the little hooves running?

lines.zh: 前后都有我的人
lines.en: There are mine in front and behind.

lines.zh: 别砍触手，砍了会长
lines.en: Do not cut my tendrils; they grow back.

lines.zh: 你只剩一条路了
lines.en: Only one road is left to you.

lines.zh: 我的孩子已经贴住你的小腿。
lines.en: My child is already against your calf.

lines.zh: 咬一口，你就少一块
lines.en: One bite and you are one piece smaller.

lines.zh: 我的牙很多，不用挑
lines.en: I have many teeth; no need to choose.

lines.zh: 缠住，收，别挣扎
lines.en: Coil, tighten, and do not struggle.

lines.zh: 这一下是替孩子打的
lines.en: This blow is for my children.

lines.zh: 你流血了，孩子们喜欢
lines.en: You are bleeding; the children approve.

lines.zh: 我力气不大，但一直咬
lines.en: My strength is modest, but I never stop biting.

lines.zh: 别喊，喊了会引来更多
lines.en: Do not shout; shouting draws more of us.

lines.zh: 拍开你的盾，再咬手腕
lines.en: I knock your shield aside and bite the wrist.

lines.zh: 黏液进了你的眼睛吧
lines.en: My slime got into your eyes, did it not?

lines.zh: 退开，我要护住肚子
lines.en: Back off; I must guard my belly.

lines.zh: 仪式把我从林子里叫醒
lines.en: The ritual woke me from the grove.

lines.zh: 我落地就湿了一小块地
lines.en: I landed and made a small patch of ground wet.

lines.zh: 主人画完最后一笔，我就有了
lines.en: My master finished the last stroke and I existed.

lines.zh: 第一个后裔比我还早睁眼
lines.en: My first spawn opened its eyes before I did.

lines.zh: 我带着满肚子的孩子来的
lines.en: I arrived with a belly full of children.

lines.zh: 召唤阵的味道像铁和奶
lines.en: The summoning circle smelled of iron and milk.

lines.zh: 别看我小，我能一直生
lines.en: Small as I am, I can birth endlessly.

lines.zh: 从黑暗中挤出来，很疼
lines.en: Squeezing out of the dark hurt.

lines.zh: 我出生时铃铛还没挂上
lines.en: The bell was not yet on me when I was born.

lines.zh: 这片林子从此多了一种味道
lines.en: The grove has held one more scent since.

lines.zh: 我一到，孩子们就开始动
lines.en: The moment I arrived, the children stirred.

lines.zh: 使魔没有名字，只有主人
lines.en: A familiar has no name, only a master.

lines.zh: 第一件事，是找主人
lines.en: The first task is finding my master.

lines.zh: 我的脚印从阵里开始
lines.en: My footprints begin inside the circle.

lines.zh: 烧焦的味道像我出生那天
lines.en: That burning smell is like the day I was born.

lines.zh: 肚子先着地，孩子在抗议
lines.en: My belly hit first and the children are complaining.

lines.zh: 水灌进触手里，我很不喜欢
lines.en: Water filled my tendrils; I dislike it greatly.

lines.zh: 炸飞了半身，剩下的还会动
lines.en: Half of me blew away; the rest still moves.

lines.zh: 箭插在肉里，像根刺
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my flesh like a thorn.

lines.zh: 魔法照见了我真正的样子
lines.en: Your magic showed my true shape.

lines.zh: 我不吃，孩子还等着
lines.en: I do not eat; the children are still waiting.

lines.zh: 雷声吓到了我肚子里的
lines.en: The thunder frightened the ones inside me.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，我抱紧了孩子
lines.en: As I fell, I clutched the children tight.
